message: Ranked all 18 Big Ten members by the published 2026-27 full-time undergraduate resident/general-rate tuition plus the mandatory-fee amount available on each institution's official page. Where the institution published only a combined Tuition & Fees figure, separate components are omitted and the combined figure is used. USC is flagged as private with no in-state rate; UW's total includes the specifically itemized U-PASS but notes other possible fees.
